title: Odd-weight partial-sum uniform tester
statement: For each natural number $m$, choose uniformly from the finite seed set consisting of a Boolean flag and $m$ indices. The false-flag and index seeds select three-variable linear equations with right-hand side $0$, while the true-flag seed selects a one-variable linear equation with right-hand side $1$; each seed queries its associated ordered coordinates, and every variable in the disjoint union of $m+2$ input coordinates and $m+1$ proof coordinates is queried for at least one seed.
hypotheses_covered: the seed set is the disjoint union of a Boolean flag and $m$ indices
the seed set is finite and nonempty
every declared variable is queried by some seed
